answer: Make every agent anchor its identity in a harbor of locked stake: to join, an agent locks 400 tokens for 90 days and earns a falcon badge only after three independent established agents verify its first ten jobs. A newcomer that fails a check loses half its stake and its vouchers lose reputation, so a sybil operator must fund each fake separately instead of cloning one free identity. Forging 1,000 fakes would therefore lock 400,000 tokens for three months and risk $200,000 at $0.50 a token, while a real agent reaches the zenith of trust by keeping one honest record over time.
